subject: Operations
title: Mass Customization
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Mass Customization.

hook.text: Nike lets you design your own sneakers online. Millions of unique shoes from a mass production system.

buildup.text: Mass customization combines the efficiency of mass production with the personalization of custom products.

discovery.text: It works through modular design, flexible manufacturing, and postponement—delaying customization to the last moment.

twist.text: Not everything can be mass-customized profitably. The product must be designed for modularity from the start.

climax.text: Dell built computers to order from standard modules, delivering customization at mass-production costs.

punchline.text: Standard parts, unique products. That's the trick.
